rich-qrcode/bookmarklet/drag-to-bookmark: Drag the button below to your bookmarks bar. When you are on a page you want to generate a Rich QR code for, click the bookmarklet!
rich-qrcode/bookmarklet/info-text: This will open the Rich QRCode tool with the current page's URL.
rich-qrcode/how_to_use/step1: Enter the URL you want to generate a Rich QR code for, then click Fetch to retrieve metadata.
rich-qrcode/how_to_use/step2: Review or edit the title and URL in the Settings panel.
rich-qrcode/how_to_use/step3: Click Generate QR Code Card to preview your QR code card.
rich-qrcode/how_to_use/step4: Right-click the preview image to copy or save, or use the Download PNG or Download SVG buttons.
rich-qrcode/link_fetch/fetch_error_hint: You can provide it by yourself.
rich-qrcode/note: Generate enhanced QR code cards with title and URL information alongside the QR code.
rich-qrcode/preview/info_text: Right click to copy/save the image, or use the download buttons below.
rich-qrcode/preview/placeholder_text: Enter a URL and click Generate
rich-qrcode/tags: qrcode, image generator, card generator, link sharing
